description:
Häagen Dazs Chocolate Midnight Cookies ice cream PLANT BASED. 

Just because you eat a plamt based diet, doesn't mean you can't make amazing ice cream. No one would be able to tell this from a dairy version, it's that good!

So what do youn need to make it:

Chocolate Base:
700g of 10% Plant based half& half cream
190g Sugar
20g Dextrose
65g Cocoa Powder
(1g of stabilizer is optional)
(8.8% Fat, 19.9% sugar, 40% Solids)

Chocolate fudge:
50g Sugar
50g of 80% Chocolate
10g Cocoa Powder
50g Plant based milk
15g Corn syrup or Golden syrup
15g Coconut oil 
3g Vanilla extract

Finally, orea halves ( eat the cream in the centre 😉 )

That's it, try it, you'll be suprised. 

--------------------

Want to watch me make the OG Chocolate Midnight Cookies, check out this link:
https://youtu.be/Sc-1dZwI5zs?si=_9arcVaU4jKj8daf

Nick. I was rewatching this and thinking about recreating it. 

I had some questions. I notice this is just 8.8% fat. Why settle at that? Could you not have added a fat, to take it up to double digits? I know not all fats are equal. But curious how would you bring the fat content up? 

I put something similar to your recipe in Patrick’s ice cream calculator and it was actually pretty well balanced based on the recommended metrics.
comments.author: @mohamedsharif9736

comments.text:
You could increase fats but then you will need to rebalance the recipe. Not every ice cream will be perfect in a calculator though, the original Belgian Chocolate was way out according to his calculator but was amazing!! Sometimes you have to go with what works as opposed to what the calculator says. 
In plant based, you can increase the cream option or add something like coconut oil then rebalance.
